summary: Comprehensive feature audit completed for OpenTicket event ticketing platform. Tested all public routes, authentication flows, API endpoints, and UI components. 27/41 backend API tests passed (66%), all critical frontend routes render correctly. Main issues: some API routes return 404 at base path (expected - no GET handler), CRON job errors for missing database columns persist.

minor.issue: CRON errors for missing columns (email_settings, ticket_design) - migration script exists but needs to be run on production database
Returns 401 'Missing Authorization header' - events endpoint requires auth even for public events listing

ui_bugs.issue: Overlay div intercepts pointer events, making direct clicks on event cards fail. Users must click 'GET TICKET' button instead

action_items: Run /app/backend/migrations/add_missing_columns.sql on production Supabase database to fix CRON errors
Consider making /api/events endpoint public for unauthenticated event browsing (currently returns 401)
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ All admin routes properly protected with verifyToken + requireAdmin middleware
✅ Security: stripe_secret_key NOT exposed in API responses
✅ Gemini API key: GET is public, POST requires SuperAdmin auth
✅ Pricing tiers correctly displayed (Free $0, Pro $39, Premium $110)
✅ Currency selector working with USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD options
✅ Affiliate partner program shows 15% commission rate
✅ Find Tickets by email feature working
